propositions: Missing JIRA_PAT environment variable silently falls back to anonymous access instead of failing with a named error, violating the documented security guarantee
Settings resolution passes an empty string as the bearer token when JIRA_PAT is unset, allowing the Jira client to construct successfully and send unauthenticated requests
An operator who forgets to set JIRA_PAT receives misleading error messages about project non-existence rather than a clear credential error, making troubleshooting difficult
Protocol conformance checks fail on Python 3.11 when validation is placed in settings resolution due to property evaluation via hasattr, but validation at client construction time avoids this issue
Settings resolution must remain total and not raise on missing credentials to preserve Protocol probe safety across Python versions
PAT validation must occur at client construction time in build_client_from_settings and reject empty or whitespace-only values before any network calls
